title.narrative: Sweet Water Foundation: Research and Treatment Institute

description.narrative: Based in Grenada but operating regionally, Sweet Water Foundation: Research and Treatment Institute is the only organization in the region focused on research and treatment planning for women, girls, trans people, and other marginalized groups who have suffered from sexual violence from the time of early childhood. They are dedicated to the healing of child sexual abuse and tackle this issue through research, policy development and practice recommendations, provision of psychological treatment programs, and the design of training in psychological approaches to ending gendered inequalities and violence. The grant will support the following priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries and bank fees; - Training of trainers for cognitive and somatic therapies for child victims of sexual abuse.
